integrity: The proof is mathematical and self-contained; finite exact-rational tests corroborate but do not prove the theorem. Relevant literature was compared; unindexed equivalents may exist. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Finite bridgeless positive-length metric graphs with normalized continuous arclength and real-valued one-Lipschitz functions. The universal uniform-law bound is attained on a given graph exactly when diameter equals half its total length. No claim covers bridges, vertex atoms, arbitrary densities or non-real targets.
title: A sharp convex-order envelope for arclength Lipschitz functions on bridgeless metric graphs
